nodes.label: Clearline payment operations desk
nodes.description: Current scope: invoice/reference, funding, approved conversion, recipient payment, reconciliation and export; StableFX is optional future integration.

nodes.label: Reconciliation changes accounting only
nodes.description: Only paid testnet payments can reconcile; reconciliation does not move funds.
nodes.rationale: A matched record must not trigger another debit or substitute for beneficiary receipt proof.

nodes.label: Testnet network allowlist
nodes.description: Only Arc Testnet 5042002 and Base Sepolia 84532; CCTP domain IDs are separate.
nodes.rationale: Reject mainnet and preserve chain/RPC validation while fixing adapter identifiers.

nodes.label: Integer money and shared Arc USDC balance
nodes.description: Six-decimal integer strings and bigint; native Arc USDC 18 decimals and ERC-20 6 decimals represent the same balance.
nodes.rationale: Avoid floating-point ledger errors and double-counting the native and ERC-20 interfaces.

nodes.label: Persist signature and hash before broadcast
nodes.description: Persist original signature/hash before broadcast. Recover original receipt or replay identical signed bytes; reused journal step must match destination, calldata and value. Recognize approve and increaseAllowance. Never erase journal to retry; timeout alone cannot authorize another transfer.
nodes.rationale: Timeout or restart does not authorize duplicate transfers; all SDK submission paths still need live verification.

nodes.label: Simulation/testnet data separation
nodes.description: Simulation localStorage and testnet disk records and exports remain separate.
nodes.rationale: Synthetic outcomes must not be confused with chain evidence.

nodes.label: Loopback signer request safeguards
nodes.description: Keep Host, Origin and session-token checks with loopback binding.
nodes.rationale: These protect a local development signer but are not production identity/authentication.

nodes.label: Exclude private runtime state and secrets
nodes.description: Do not index .clearline-testnet, read wallet.json or expose keys, raw signed bytes, credentials or VITE secrets in UI, logs, exports, docs or graphs.
nodes.rationale: Generated navigation must not leak signer secrets or transaction journal material.

nodes.label: Small testnet payment limits
nodes.description: More than zero and at most 100 USDC; Base bridge currently requires more than 0.01 USDC. Fee cap is code configuration, not universal protocol guarantee.

nodes.label: CCTP V2 immutable attestation validation
nodes.description: Match immutable burn-message bytes, including hooks; validate nonzero matching nonce, sufficient executed finality and bounded fee. Circle populates nonce/finality/fee/expiration offchain, so exact full-message equality is wrong. Indexing 404 is pending.
nodes.rationale: Preserve original successful burn during indexing/attestation waits while rejecting an altered completed message.
